name: Saldelmar
summary: Worth a lunch, not a headline booking: Solís has about 40 years in the trade and strong critic support, but Google 3.5 on 46 reviews and one freshness complaint make it less proven than the famous names. A casual, product-driven seafood lunch rather than a destination tasting.

value.text: Roughly S/100-200+ pp a la carte (~US$29-59), reviewer-reported only

facts.value: Peruvian seafood driven by the day's catch with European technique: tiraditos, stews, paella-pan rices
